entry.title: New: Resolution 202 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A GRANT AWARD OF $200,000 FROM HAWAI‘I COMMUNITY FOUNDATION TO SUPPORT FINANCIAL EMPOWERMENT SERVICES

Funds would be used to support no-cost financial and homeownership counseling provided by the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development.
